tagline_en: Brightening, moisture-locking care with a dry-touch, non-greasy finish
tagline_zh: 美白光泽、细腻 · 锁水保湿 · 质地干爽、不油腻
overview_en: Contains a variety of active ingredients — Licorice (Glabridin) and plant extracts — that improve dryness caused by dehydration, collagen loss or ageing, whitening and locking in moisture for lasting, radiant skin.
overview_zh: 含光果甘草与多种植物萃取，有效帮助皮肤美白锁水保湿，改善皮肤缺水与暗沉偏黄。
claims_flagged: 有效提亮肤色…改善肌肤偏黄与暗沉问题
